ValidationRule.description: Make the Parent case lookup field mandatory if we select the type as "Operational Waiver".
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.Name == 'Service Request', ISPICKVAL(Type,'Operational Waiver') ,ParentId == '', NOT(ISPICKVAL( Problem_Type__c , 'Schedule Change')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter the value for Parent Case lookup field
